title: St Montague Village (St Alexander Circle and St Christopher Ave): two men shot dead, 18 Oct
summary: Police say two men, aged 37 and 46, were shot dead at the corner of St Alexander Circle and St Christopher Avenue in St Montague Village on Sunday evening, 18 October; Steenberg police responded at about 18:30 (Sergeant ...
story: Police say two men, aged 37 and 46, were shot dead at the corner of St Alexander Circle and St Christopher Avenue in St Montague Village on Sunday evening, 18 October; Steenberg police responded at about 18:30 (Sergeant Wesley Twigg, via Southern Mail). According to police, two suspects approached the men, opened fire and fled on foot. Police believe the motive may be gang-related. Steenberg detectives are investigating two counts of murder. No arrest has been reported. The victims were not named. One report found, resting on police: Southern Mail; Briefly News mentions the shooting later without new detail. Not the St Montague Village shooting of 7 October, which is a separate pin.
